en: Sepia-toned street view showing a gently curving road lined with buildings. Dominating the scene is a large multi-storey school building with a decorative gable and small tower, fronted by a columned porch. To the right is a traditional half-timbered house. In the distance, additional multi-storey buildings line the rising street, and a clock tower is visible further up. A few pedestrians, including children and a woman, stand on the cobbled street, and an early horse-drawn or small vehicle is seen further up the road. Printed captions at the top read 'Sebnitz i. Sa.' and 'Weberstrasse und Schule'.
